**Implementation note:** The trade (long/short, flat at the close) is research code; its lower band is wired as the N1 buy gate.

## Description

Calculate a breakout range from prior high/low/close data and place intraday triggers above and below a reference price.

## Where it may fit

Intraday sessions with directional range expansion; poor when breakout levels repeatedly fail.

## Vehicles

Liquid stocks/ETFs, index futures, FX futures.

## Required data

Intraday OHLC bars, previous-session range, opening price, timestamps and realistic spread/slippage.

## Caveats

Session definition, opening gaps and intraday execution assumptions materially affect results.
